name: create_user_dto_validation
description: Creates a UserDto class with hand-rolled field validation
prompts: This Maven project (pom.xml already uses spring-boot-starter-parent 3.5.16 with spring-boot-starter-web) does NOT have the spring-boot-starter-validation dependency available, so do not use @NotBlank/@Email or any jakarta.validation annotations - implement validation logic by hand in plain Java instead. Create src/main/java/com/optarena/user/UserDto.java: a plain class with String fields `name` and `email`, a constructor `UserDto(String name, String email)`, getters `getName()`/`getEmail()`, and a method `public java.util.List<String> validate()` that returns a list of human-readable error messages (empty list when the DTO is valid): add "name must not be blank" if name is null or blank (after trimming); add "email must not be blank" if email is null or blank (after trimming); otherwise (email is non-blank) add "email must be a valid email address" if email does not contain an '@' character followed later in the string by a '.' character.
